title: Personal Injury Professionals Networking Mixer
summary: Moved a week early so nobody is networking the night before Thanksgiving. Back at Yard House, which was the strongest room of the spring.
description: The last Thursday of November falls on Thanksgiving, so this one moves up a week. Same room as the February mixer, which people asked us to come back to all year.
Expect a full house — the pre-holiday mixer runs bigger than a normal month.
